user.title: Community Apps
user.description:
Adds a **Community Apps** page to the sidebar (administrators only) to browse a community catalog of third-party apps and add their repositories to the app store.

Each repository was reviewed by a person when it entered the catalog and is rescanned automatically when it changes. The review lists signals (permissions, domains contacted); it does not prove an app is harmless.

abort.no_supervisor: Apps need a Supervisor (Home Assistant OS or Supervised). This installation has none.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Community Apps is already set up.

app_flagged.title: {app}: back in review in Community Apps
app_flagged.description:
The repository **{repository}** of the installed app **{app}** changed and is back in review: {reason}.

The update may already be installed. Check what changed before using the app further.

app_removed.title: {app}: removed from Community Apps
app_removed.description:
The repository **{repository}** of the installed app **{app}** was removed from the catalog: {reason}.

The app stays installed. Decide whether you want to keep it.
